OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Any non-digit characters are
            stripped on create; exactly 10 digits must remain.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permit creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID

              type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Any non-digit characters are
            stripped on create; exactly 10 digits must remain.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permit creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners that were created into the same
                household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: 8d1f7c3e-2a4b-3c5d-9e6f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared its first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation:
                starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount
                is 0, capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today at
                the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: PHONE
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and
                householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners are
                duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Any non-digit characters are
            stripped on create; exactly 10 digits must remain.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permit creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners that were created into the same
                household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: 8d1f7c3e-2a4b-3c5d-9e6f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared its first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation:
                starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount
                is 0, capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today at
                the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: PHONE
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and
                householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners are
                duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented optional, region-validated `postcode` support for owners while keeping structural impact low — no existing method was modified.

**What I changed:**
1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `postcode` property to `OwnerFields` with a `^[0-9]{4}$` pattern (generates the automatic 400 on malformed input), and attached a class-level `x-class-extra-annotation` (`@PostcodeValidation`) to the schema for the cross-field city/postcode check. Since `Owner` includes `OwnerFields` via `allOf`, the field is both accepted on input and returned in responses.
2. **`Owner.java`** — Added a `postcode` column field with a plain getter/setter (a small, self-contained addition; no existing method touched). MapStruct auto-maps it by name in both directions, so no mapper edit was needed.
3. **`rest/validation/PostcodeValidation.java`** (new) — A single self-contained file holding the constraint annotation plus its validator. The validator returns valid when postcode is absent or not 4 digits (leaving the `@Pattern` to reject malformed values), consults the existing `Localities.regionOf(city)`, accepts any postcode for a city with no known region, and otherwise enforces the inclusive range (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099). Because it runs as a `@Valid` request-body constraint, out-of-range values surface as `MethodArgumentNotValidException` → **400**.
4. **DB schemas** — Added the `postcode` column to all four `owners` DDL files (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres) and bumped the positional hsqldb seed inserts.
